If you’ve recently graduated or are about to graduate, with a degree in Quantity Surveying, and you're ready to take charge of your future with a leading building contractor, we could be the perfect fit. This is your opportunity to make an impact and grow with us. **Who We Are** Established in 1859, Sisk is proud to be in its fifth generation of family ownership. Our founding values of care, excellence, and integrity continue to shape everything we do. With a clear vision of Building Excellence, we consistently deliver high-quality projects that exceed client expectations. Our people are the driving force behind our success, and we’re now looking for the next generation of graduates to help us carry that legacy forward. **A journey to your future** Our Graduate Programme is a carefully designed 27-month rotational journey that offers up to three business rotations across the UK and Ireland, giving you broad exposure and the opportunity to shape your career path, fusing technical excellence, commercial acumen, and leadership capabilities. From day one, you'll follow a detailed development plan aligned to a clear timeline, ensuring you gain the experience and competencies required to pursue professional chartership. We’re committed to helping you build a strong technical foundation and excel in your chosen area of specialism. The programme blends structured learning, hands-on project work, and expert mentoring to deliver both depth and breadth of knowledge. With robust progress tracking, regular feedback, and a dedicated support network, you’ll be empowered to grow with confidence and make a meaningful impact. **What We are looking For** * A collaborative team player with fresh ideas, ready to challenge yourself, and us, every step of the way. With a passion for the built environment and a drive to make a difference, you’ll bring curiosity, resilience, and a commitment to technical excellence. * Recently graduated or be on track to graduate with a Quantity Surveying degree, ready to join Sisk’s Early Careers Graduate Programme in September 2027. Over 27 months, you’ll complete up to three rotations across the business gaining exposure to live projects, commercial operations, and technical delivery. * Geographic mobility is essential - you’ll be expected to work across the UK and Ireland, including at least one rotation outside of your home jurisdiction. The selection process has been designed to ensure that we, as a company, select the right individuals that will thrive with us, but also that you, as a candidate, select the right company to build and shape your career with. In return, you will receive a competitive salary, a focused and structured start to your career and its progression in the construction industry, with excellent support and guidance every step of the way. If your application is successful, you will be required to participate in an online psychometric assessment. The programme will commence in September 2027.

title: Network Operations Analyst
description: **Based on site in Ballsbridge, early mornings and weekend work required** The Network Operations Engineer I is an entry-level technical role. Engineers I monitor, triage and maintain the health of Optical and IP networks in a 24x7 operational environment. This role is the first point of response for network alarms and incidents. It works closely with Network Operations Engineers II, who act as its escalation point, and with Team Leads to restore service and keep the network stable. The role is hands-on and follows defined procedures. Engineers I detect and acknowledge alarms, carry out first-level troubleshooting using established runbooks, open and document tickets, and support scheduled maintenance under guidance. Issues that go beyond first-level diagnosis are escalated promptly to Engineers II with clear initial findings. Engineers I build their skills through structured training, shadowing and mentorship. **Scope** * Serve as the first-level response point for optical and IP network alarms and incidents. * Monitor network health using NOC monitoring and alarm management tools, and acknowledge alarms within defined response times. * Perform first-level triage and troubleshooting following established runbooks and procedures. * Escalate incidents to Network Operations Engineers II with accurate initial diagnostics. * Create, update and maintain tickets with clear, accurate documentation. * Support scheduled maintenance activities and network changes under the direction of senior engineers. * Develop technical knowledge of optical and IP technologies through training, shadowing and mentorship. **Roles and Responsibilities** **Monitoring, Incident Response & First-Level Troubleshooting** * Monitor optical and IP network alarms, events and performance dashboards across a 24x7 environment. * Acknowledge, prioritise and triage alarms and incidents according to severity and defined response times. * Perform first-level troubleshooting of optical (DWDM, CWDM) and IP (IPv4/IPv6, MPLS, BGP, OSPF) networks using runbooks. This includes checking optical power levels, interface status, alarm states, protocol adjacencies and basic connectivity. * Gather initial diagnostic information such as logs, alarm history, interface counters and recent changes to support fault isolation. * Escalate incidents that cannot be resolved at first level to Network Operations Engineers II, with clear findings and the steps already taken. * Support senior engineers during major service-impacting incidents by running checks, gathering data and keeping tickets updated. **Ticket & Case Management** * Create, update and close tickets with accurate, detailed and timely documentation for all work performed. * Open cases with vendor TACs (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, Nokia, Infinera) when directed, and provide the requested logs and diagnostics. * Track open tickets and vendor cases, and follow up to ensure timely progress. * Verify basic service restoration after an incident and record the outcome in the ticket. * Notify internal stakeholders and customers of incidents using approved communication templates. **Maintenance & Change Support** * Support scheduled maintenance activities and network changes under the direction of Engineers II or III, including pre- and post-change checks. * Follow approved method-of-procedure (MOP) documents and change management processes. * Assist with turn-up and testing of new circuits, services and network elements. * Coordinate with field technicians, colocation facilities, ISPs and service providers to arrange access, dispatches and testing. **Learning, Process & Collaboration** * Complete structured training and shadow senior engineers to build optical and IP troubleshooting skills. * Follow runbooks and procedures, and flag gaps or inaccuracies to senior engineers for update. * Contribute to knowledge-base articles under the review of senior engineers. * Participate in shift handoffs and produce clear, complete shift-turnover notes. * Work collaboratively with NOC colleagues, Engineering and other operational teams. **Required Qualifications & Skills** * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 0–2 years of experience in network operations, IT support, or a related technical role; internships or lab experience are considered. * Foundational knowledge of IP networking (TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, routing and switching concepts), with awareness of BGP, OSPF and MPLS. * Basic understanding of optical transport concepts (DWDM, CWDM, fiber types, optics, patch panels) and optical power levels. * Familiarity with network device command-line interfaces (CLI). * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to follow procedures accurately. * Good written and verbal communication skills, including clear ticket documentation. * Willingness to learn, take direction and escalate appropriately. * Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 shift-based operational environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Associate-level certifications such as CCNA, JNCIA, Nokia NRS I, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent. * Exposure to multi-vendor network equipment (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, Nokia, Infinera). * Basic familiarity with fiber testing tools (OTDR, power meters, light sources). * Experience with NOC monitoring, alarm management and ticketing platforms. * Awareness of ITIL-based incident and change management processes. * Interest in scripting or automation (e.g., Python). **Physical Demands & Work Environment** * Ability to perform office-related tasks, including prolonged sitting or standing. * Capability to move within an office environment and effectively use a computer. * Must have strong communication skills for effective collaboration and coordination. * Occasional repetitive motions of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers may be required. * Availability to work rotating shifts, including weekends, and holidays as required in a 24x7 environment.

description: At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing. Sales Development Representative - English & EU Language Why We Have This Role The Sales Development Representative role is crucial to Qualtrics as it serves as the first point of contact for potential clients, helping to generate qualified leads that drive revenue growth. By engaging with decision-makers across various industries, SDRs gather insights that not only inform sales strategies but also enhance the overall understanding of market needs. This role helps create a robust sales pipeline, ensuring that Account Executives have quality prospects to engage with. Additionally, the SDR team plays a vital role in fostering collaboration with marketing, enhancing targeted campaigns that resonate with potential customers. Ultimately, SDRs contribute significantly to the company’s growth and success by laying the groundwork for meaningful customer relationships. How You’ll Find Success * You identify key decision makers and/or key influencers within an organisation across many different departments * You understand the impact our products have on our customers * You articulate to prospects how our tools can help their organisations get to the next level with real-time data * You work well with teammates, like to strategise, and plan out creative methods to generate more business opportunities * You use rejection as fuel to motivate and push you to work harder and smarter * You’re a self starter, competitive, and driven. You see the bigger picture. You don’t settle for mediocrity * You don’t hit quota because that is what is expected of you, rather you blow past quota because it’s who you are * Money, opportunity for growth, and promotion motivate you * You are in sales because you want to drive your own destiny * You view this opportunity as a career, not as a job How You’ll Grow * Sales Development is a rapidly growing division within the sales organisation. * Purpose of the department: + Generate qualified pipeline that progresses through the sales funnel and produces new closed revenue. + Develop new quota-carrying Account Executives. * Due to growth, we’re constantly looking for hungry and driven individuals who are passionate about a career in corporate sales. Things You’ll Do * You make 50+ calls and send 50+ personalised emails per day. In addition, you find and add 15+ new contacts to into your call cadence. * You work with Account Executives to discuss and strategise methods to penetrate targeted accounts with the goal of setting quality meetings. * You work closely with our Marketing team to execute on personalised account-based campaigns * You’re the best with LinkedIn and Salesforce. * You attend 1:1’s, team meetings, trainings, sales calls, discovery calls, demos, etc. to develop your skills. * You collaborate with your peers sharing standard methodologies, “oops moments,” and role playing to make sure you’re focused on continuous improvement. * You compete with yourself, your co-workers, and other teams. * You’re self disciplined, accountable, and reliable. description: **Company Description** Radius Vehicle Solutions (RVS) is part of Radius Payment Solutions, a market-leading global business solutions provider. Radius Vehicle Solutions Ireland is a growing company, priding ourselves on our customer-focused approach and attention to detail. We take the time to understand our customer’s needs before we propose any of our fleet solutions, continually refining our offering so it consistently delivers to our customer’s expectations. Our people are crucial to the success of our business. They help us develop new and innovative products across a growing range of businesses, from fleet telematics insurance to electric vehicle charging and vehicle hiring solutions. We like to nurture our team and give them a wide range of opportunities to grow within the business, helping them become experts in their chosen area and leaders for the future. **Job Description** Reporting to the Head of Operations, the Sales Support Executive is a valued member of the team. With a variety of tasks, the Sales Support Executive is primarily responsible for all ROI vehicle quoting, vehicle recommendations, arranging of vehicle fit outs, assigning appropriate funding and accurate deal preparation - through to the end process of all vehicle deliveries. The role involves working alongside both sales and finance team, providing high quality and administrative support, working collaboratively across all aspects of sales administration, including our office in Northern Ireland (NI). There is a key focus on product knowledge, quoting accuracy, customer service excellence and pro-active process management based on our customer’s requirements. You will work closely with our ROI fleet customers, their drivers, our preferred suppliers and our internal functions, in providing industry expertise for choice of vehicles, ordering vehicles through to vehicle delivery. **Key Duties** * Preparation and guidance for delivery of our ROI new vehicle quoting, supporting the Sales team on all new business opportunities. * Responsible for efficient management of all ROI new vehicle orders and vehicle deliveries for both contract hire and rental stock. * Placing vehicle orders for ROI directly with our preferred supplier network. * Support preparation for funding proposals, and gather all information required to submit final funding documents and invoicing to all funders. * Responsible for arranging all vehicle fit outs in time for grade lists, procedures and policies. * Carry out daily reviews of all outstanding orders in the order bank, continually executing next steps based on all vehicle ETA’s. * Provide our NI office with improvements across internal processes and optimising all customer procedures across departments * Work collaboratively with key business partners and suppliers for all industry knowledge, advice and excellent customer service delivery * Work with our Operations team to meet both department and set company objectives * Resolve customer complaints quickly and effectively and support internal compliance for recording and management of all complaints **Qualifications** * A minimum of 2:2 in any degree * 1-2 years experience in the automotive/finance sector an advantage * Customer driven fluctuating workloads & prioritisation of daily tasks * Ability to see issues through to completion and work to deadlines * Adopt a professional approach, demonstrating high standards of performance, title: Trainee Merchandiser – Placement Student
description: **Trainee Merchandiser — Student Placement Year** **Because you’ll make the difference** Ready to own your career in an ever-growing fashion hub? Then take on a Primark placement starting in Summer 2027. This is your chance to grab valuable experience in a global company that truly feels like a family. You’ll have real projects with real autonomy. You’ll get to know incredible experts who make our fashion a reality. And you’ll gain off-the-scale exposure, making a huge impact for our customers and your future. Want it? Then own it on our undergraduate placement programme. **Because you matter** People are at the heart of what we do, so it’s essential that we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. We offer benefits that put you first: * Pay rate: Generous EUR 30,000 salary * Development: A 12 month development programme which kicks off with our Freshers Week * Balance: Our ‘Your Day, Your Way’ approach means you can finish up at 2pm every Friday if you’ve done your 37.5 hours that week * Discounts: Use your in-store colleague discount across our fabulous range * Support: Explore our well-being initiatives and Employee Assistance Programme, Let’s Talk. As well as mentorship to get the most out of your year * Holiday: Enjoy 27 days holiday on top of the Bank Holidays And if you need to relocate to Dublin for the role: * We’ll support you with opening a bank account and registering for tax and social security in Ireland. * Not sure where to live? Primark will help with finding accommodation for the year. **About You** If you’re an undergraduate looking for a 12 month placement before you head back to university for your final year, we’d love to hear from you. If you’re in your last year at university or have already graduated, head back to the careers website to find other roles across the business. **What You’ll Need** You have a genuine connection and interest in numbers and figures, an eye for detail and a real awareness of timelines — even when the pressure is on. You’ll use your curiosity to get to know our network of professionals and drive excellence. You won’t be short of initiative either. In fact, you’ll be happy to handle your own workload with the support of others. If you’re studying Fashion, Business Management, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics or a Commercial based degree, the Primark placement in Merchandising is the perfect fit for you. **What You’ll Do** After induction, you’ll get stuck into sales and stock monitoring, solving data inaccuracies, and producing analysis reports. You’ll learn about a department by doing real work with your teams on tasks and projects. You’ll strengthen relationships and share your ideas at team meetings, grow what you know at masterclasses, and have regular catch ups with your assigned buddy and line manager to support your development. So when you present to your Director at the end of your placement, you won’t be short of things to say. **Why should you apply?** In Primark, we’ve always said everyone’s invited and we’re committed to making everyone feel safe and comfortable to be themselves. We believe that a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment elevates us all, and enables creative ideas and collaboration to flourish. Because when we work together, we can accomplish so much more. And yes, this place moves fast, and it’s growing even faster but we’re committed to providing the best, and most socially and environmentally ethical fashion that’s affordable for everyone. Primark Cares is our commitment to reducing fashion waste, halving our carbon footprint, and improving the lives of the people who make our products. This placement has real impact, you could even see the results of your work, out on the shop floor! Make your CV look amazing and if you wow us, there could be a permanent job up for grabs when you graduate. **Isn’t it time you put theory into practice? We think so. Apply now for a Primark placement and start owning your journey.** **About The Placement** You don’t watch from the sidelines around here — you get stuck in. Through hands-on experience and responsibility from the get-go, you’ll gain a vast insight into how our business works and contribute to it from day one. Inspiring, supportive colleagues will make you feel welcome and valued. And we’ll also help you to develop your skill set and grow your potential through supported learning with on-the-job training, masterclasses, and an assigned buddy. **Before applying, please ensure that i** **f you are offered a place on the programme, it has been approved by your university or educational institution.** **Closing date: Friday, 6th November 2026. We reserve the right to close the application window early should we receive sufficient applications** **REQ ID:** JR-14779

title: Training & Technical Support Specialist
description: **Location:** Dublin 2 **Working:** Hybrid – 3 days in office, 2 days WFH **Travel:** Occasional travel to London We are looking for a **Training & IT Support Specialist** to join a growing insurance technology business. This is a varied, people-focused role combining **client training, application support and internal IT support** . You will train customers on our insurance platforms, handle technical queries and also provide day-to-day IT support to internal users. Key Responsibilities * Train new and existing clients on insurance software and platforms. * Provide first-line application and technical support by phone, email and ticketing system. * Troubleshoot user, software and access issues and escalate where required. * Set up new starters, laptops, accounts and applications. * Manage general IT support tickets and assist with Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365. * Support Microsoft Intune and Azure environments. * Assist with software testing and new product releases. * Build strong relationships with customers and act as a key point of contact. * Occasionally travel to London for client training or meetings. About You We're looking for someone who is: * Confident speaking with customers and comfortable on the phone. * Friendly, personable and customer-focused. * Technically minded with good problem-solving skills. * Comfortable explaining technology to non-technical users. * Organised and able to manage multiple queries at once. * Experienced in **IT support, application support, software training or a similar role** . Technical Experience Experience with some of the following would be beneficial: **Microsoft 365 / Office | Intune | Azure | ASP.NET | SaaS | Ticketing Systems | AWS** Insurance or InsurTech experience is desirable but **not essential** . This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys a **mix of people, technology, training and problem-solving** , rather than a purely technical IT support position.

title: Treasury Middle Office
description: Ryanair, over our 40 year history has grown to become Europe’s largest airline group connecting more guests across more routes than any other European carrier.
